caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular grid composed of small, regularly repeating geometric shapes resembling a checkerboard and plaid patterns. The primary colors used are red, dark blue, and beige/tan, distributed in an alternating and intersecting arrangement. The leftmost three columns in the upper two-thirds of the design feature a checkerboard motif, where red and blue squares are arranged in a tight, alternating sequence and are bordered by thin lines of beige. The rightmost columns transition into a different pattern where larger red rectangles are evenly spaced within primarily beige fields, intersecting with linear accents of blue and red. In the lower portion of the image, the right section contains blocks of alternating narrow stripes and checkerboard sections, echoing the color and line arrangements seen above but with more line-based than block-based components. The entire grid is surrounded by a blank off-white margin, and a signature appears in the lower right corner outside the main patterned area.
title: Red, White & Blue Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
